newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Pekao bank to get rating from two agencies.
newsitem.headline: Polish Pekao bank to get rating from two agencies.

text.p: Poland's state-owned commercial bank Pekao SA will soon get a rating from Moody's investor service and one other major rating agency, Pekao SA's president Andrzej Dorosz told a news conference on Wednesday.

"We asked two well known rating agencies to present their offers of giving a rating...and we will choose one of them. Moody's Investor Service will do the rating for Pekao SA without our invitation," Dorosz said.
"We expect the rating in the near future," he said but declined to give any firm date.
He said the ratings were likely to take into account that Pekao SA is leading a banking group of three other state-owned commercial banks under a banking sector consolidating scheme.
Poland has a Baa3 rating from Moody's, BBB- from Standard and Poor's and BBB from IBCA.
